userStories.title: Per-Origin Preschool Passive Content (Gap Reduction)
userStories.description: As a player, I want more origin-flavored passive beats ages 3–7 so runs feel less like neutral gap filler.
acceptanceCriteria: Add ≥2 new entries per origin tag in preschool-passive-spine.json (or approved catalog path)
Each entry: unique id, originTags, age band 3–7, non-empty text (schema per design §2.1)
validatePreschoolPassiveOriginTags and US-004 spine rules still pass

userStories.title: Poor Trait Spine Minimum Pack
userStories.description: As a player with poor_family trait, I want at least one formative childhood spine beat.
acceptanceCriteria: Add ≥1 event age 3–7 with condition flags.has("origin_poor_family") only (no four-main OR)
Unit test: scholar primary + origin_poor_family → event eligible; scholar without poor → ineligible
userStories.notes: PRD §4 US-004; §3 frozen (poor condition only origin_poor_family or poor successor flag, no four-main OR); §5 FR-2; §7 poor trait spine ≥1; design §2.2 G2 (reference p22_childhood_street_shaping tone); may parallel US-003 after US-001–US-002; US-005 requires US-004 complete

userStories.title: Final Playtest Gap Regression
